note:
Model-scale axis, third point. The KV-quantisation result so far rests on two model
sizes, and with two points a matching pair of fp8 values cannot be told apart from
coincidence. Qwen3-8B dense sits between the 4B dense and the 30B MoE and shares the 4B's
architecture, so it isolates parameter count from the dense/MoE difference.

What would falsify the claim: if fp8 pins mis_kl to a value set by the quantisation format
rather than by the model, the three fp8_e4m3 cells should agree far more tightly than the
three bf16 cells differ, and the fp8 spread should stay within the seed-to-seed spread
measured on 4B. A third point that lands outside that band says the earlier agreement was
coincidence.

Step 0 only (NUM_ROLLOUT=1): no optimizer step, so what is measured is the numerical-path
gap alone.

cells.name: 8b_bf16
cells.note: Baseline: no KV quantisation. This is the number the two fp8 cells are amplified from.

cells.name: 8b_e5m2
cells.note: KV cache in fp8_e5m2: fewer mantissa bits than e4m3, so the coarser of the two.
